points.point: A court judgment reduced patent infringement damages owed to Centripetal Networks to $114 million while legal appeals remain pending.
points.quote: After post-trial motions, a judgment was issued on October 3, 2024 affirming infringement on three patents, reversing infringement on the fourth patent, and subsequently, reducing the damages amount to $ 114 million.

points.point: In the first quarter of fiscal 2027, the company reevaluated its reporting units and reassigned goodwill following a change in operating segments.
points.quote: Due to the change in our operating segments in the first quarter of fiscal 2027, we reevaluated our reporting units and reassigned goodwill to each reporting unit based on their relative fair value.

points.point: On November 18, 2026, the company agreed to acquire Applied Compute, Inc. for $4.5 billion in common stock.
points.quote: On November 18, 2026, we entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Applied Compute, Inc., a privately-held AI technology company (“Applied Compute”).
